quests.title: Returns at Robin Thomas
quests.blurb: I'll be straight with you. I am sending back 20 papers a day from Robin Thomas and paying to have them collected, which is a business model somebody invented on purpose. It has been going on longer than I have admitted to anyone. You'll know it when you see it.

steps.label: the returns stack, at its worst
the distributor needs to see the size of it

quests.title: The Better Rate, Robin Thomas
quests.blurb: It has been three weeks. They will drop my Robin Thomas order if I can show $47 of turnover on the other side of the shop by grand final week. I have got no proof, which is exactly why I am asking. Half now if you want it. Most people don't.

steps.label: $47, and cards and stationery count
sell anything, I am not proud

quests.title: The Robin Thomas Round
quests.blurb: Nobody else has offered, so. I do the Robin Thomas round from ten past five and for the last fortnight somebody has been taking the papers off the front steps behind me. It might be nothing. It has not felt like nothing. Whatever it costs you, tell me and I will cover it.

steps.label: the end of the round, where it starts
whoever is on that street at that hour

quests.title: The Dog on Ash Street, Robin Thomas
quests.blurb: The council knows and the council does not care. There is a dog on the Robin Thomas round that has had two of my bags and a chest freezer that hums in D that was not even mine. I would not ask if there was anyone else about. I would rather know than wonder.

steps.label: you will want your wits about you
the owner, not the dog, I am not a monster
tell me it is sorted

quests.title: The Syndicate, Robin Thomas
quests.blurb: I have been putting it off since Easter. Nine of us at Robin Thomas have gone in on the same numbers since grand final week and one of us has stopped putting money in. You can tell me I am imagining it. Tell me after. That's the whole job. No catch.

steps.label: the house of the one who stopped
$20, which is his share since he stopped
I want it said out loud, not in the group chat

quests.title: The Other Agency, Robin Thomas
quests.blurb: Before you say anything: yes, I know. The agency at Prince Alfred Square closed six months before Robin Thomas started struggling, and I would very much like to know what they know. I would have sorted it myself a year ago. Be polite about it. It costs nothing.

steps.label: the shop is shut, the family is not
whatever they say, say it slowly to me

quests.title: The Unclaimed Falcon, Pymble
quests.blurb: I'll be straight with you. There has been a car in the Pymble yard since the first of the month with a chest freezer that hums in D on the passenger seat and no owner answering. It has been going on longer than I have admitted to anyone. You'll know it when you see it.

steps.label: the car and the plate together
I have to prove I tried before I can move it

quests.title: Storage Fees, Pymble
quests.blurb: It has been three weeks. Now that it is documented, Pymble is owed $49 in storage and the only person who can pay it is the person not answering. I have got no proof, which is exactly why I am asking. Half now if you want it. Most people don't.

steps.label: $49, from him or from the scrap
either way it comes off my floor

quests.title: First Year, Pymble
quests.blurb: Nobody else has offered, so. I am in my first year at Pymble and I have to log 17 hours on a job I am not allowed to touch on my own. It might be nothing. It has not felt like nothing. Whatever it costs you, tell me and I will cover it.

steps.label: the supplier, two streets over
and get him a coffee, it helps
sign the book and I owe you

quests.title: The Air Line, Pymble
quests.blurb: The council knows and the council does not care. Somebody has been coming into the Pymble yard after quarter to six to use the air line, and last week they used the compressor as well. I would not ask if there was anyone else about. I would rather know than wonder.

steps.label: the ones who think the yard is public
the gate they are getting through

quests.title: My Own Car, Pymble
quests.blurb: I have been putting it off since Easter. My car has been at Pymble since the first of the month and every time I ring, the quote has grown by about $17. You can tell me I am imagining it. Tell me after. That's the whole job. No catch.

steps.label: stand in the office where they can see you
the job card on the wall, all of it
now I know what I am arguing about

quests.title: The Assessor, Pymble
quests.blurb: Before you say anything: yes, I know. The insurance assessor who signs off every job at Pymble works out of Turramurra, and he has never once seen the car he is assessing. I would have sorted it myself a year ago. Be polite about it. It costs nothing.

steps.label: catch him before he goes out on the road
I want to hear how he does it

quests.title: Dumped Out the Back, Denistone
quests.blurb: I'll be straight with you. People leave things at the Denistone roller door after twenty past four and by morning it is rained on and it is our problem and our tip fee. It has been going on longer than I have admitted to anyone. You'll know it when you see it.

steps.label: the pile, on a bad morning
the council will not act without one of these

quests.title: The Tip Fee, Denistone
quests.blurb: It has been three weeks. The photos worked, which means Denistone can claim back the $43 we have paid to throw away other people's furniture since every second Friday. I have got no proof, which is exactly why I am asking. Half now if you want it. Most people don't.

steps.label: $43, and every receipt counts
I will do the form if you do the walking

quests.title: The Good Box, Denistone
quests.blurb: Nobody else has offered, so. Something came into Denistone on every second Friday in a box of paperbacks that I do not think the family meant to give away. It might be nothing. It has not felt like nothing. Whatever it costs you, tell me and I will cover it.

steps.label: the address on the donation slip
the thing itself, before it goes back
I would rather give it back than sell it

quests.title: Sorting Room, Denistone
quests.blurb: The council knows and the council does not care. Two people have been coming into the Denistone sorting room since every second Friday and taking the good stock before it reaches the floor, and one of them volunteers here. I would not ask if there was anyone else about. I would rather know than wonder.

steps.label: catch them at the back door
$55, which is what the good stock made last month

quests.title: The Van, Denistone
quests.blurb: I have been putting it off since Easter. I do the Denistone pick-ups in a van with 55 thousand on it and a door that only opens if you know about it. You can tell me I am imagining it. Tell me after. That's the whole job. No catch.

steps.label: come out to West Ryde with me, it is a two-person lift
we will stop on the way, my shout

quests.title: Head Office, Denistone
quests.blurb: Before you say anything: yes, I know. Everything Denistone cannot sell goes to a warehouse at West Ryde, and nobody there has ever answered a phone in my hearing. I would have sorted it myself a year ago. Be polite about it. It costs nothing.

steps.label: turn up in person, that is the trick
tell me there is a person in there
